verdict_per_use_case.rationale: Acceptance criteria trace to tests/CI lane runs, and promoted changesets trace to merged PRs and audit-chain rows.
Compliance controls now traverse to lane satisfaction and evidence paths through semantic KG edge types plus read-side freshness query.
Closed incidents now traverse mechanically to root-cause change nodes and PullRequest nodes, and CloseIncident declares audit-topic emission plus validator recheck of I16.
Candidate diff files can now be joined to KG nodes, downstream graph edges, deterministic blast_radius_score signals, and downstream consumers before review dispatch.
Agent decisions are now graph nodes with recursive caused_by traversal and evidence refs.

overall_verdict.robust_enough_for_development: YES (3-layer architecture sound; F-KG-01 through F-KG-06 resolved through additive node/edge/query/invariant declarations)
overall_verdict.robust_enough_for_governance: YES (compliance, incident root-cause, blast-radius, agent decision provenance, acceptance/test/CI traceability, and ChangeSet/PR/audit-row provenance are graph-traversable)
overall_verdict.recommendation: F-KG-01 through F-KG-06 are closed. Keep future KG changes additive and covered by knowledge_graph_semantic.rs registry tests.
